parent_objective: implement no-PPO normal-margin-aware residual calibrator around frozen M761 residual head

public_gates: M783 freezes base actor and M761 residual head
M783 reports active source margin and intervention gap metrics
M783 blocks PPO and checkpoint promotion
forbidden_shortcuts: do not mutate M761 residual head
do not use terminal margin or fault labels as deploy-time inputs
do not claim broad generalization or true four-wheel physical fidelity

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: implements the first no-PPO calibrator probe to test whether low-margin normal suppression can coexist with intervention sensitivity
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: implementation diagnostic only; no PPO or driver promotion
stop_condition: stop if base actor or residual head checksum changes
stop if implementation cannot reconstruct required rows
stop if calibrator uses deploy-time oracle inputs
fallback_plan: if calibrator collapses residual everywhere, redesign intervention gate floor
if normal collisions remain, increase normal-margin retention or mine more boundary rows
if exact metrics improve but replay fails, split exact objective from replay implementation
if tooling is too large, implement objective sanity before full replay

hypothesis: A small calibrator around the frozen M761 residual head can reduce residual action on low-margin normal branches while preserving intervention-sensitive residual separation.
success_criteria: M783 writes calibrator tooling and run artifacts
M783 confirms actor and residual head checksums unchanged
M783 reports whether calibrated alpha 0.2 or 0.125 passes strict normal retention and gap gates
failure_criteria: implementation mutates base actor or residual head
implementation uses oracle labels as deploy-time inputs
implementation omits active boundary source metrics

commands.name: calibration_probe
commands.command: implement and run normal-margin-aware residual calibration probe; expected module src/autodrift/v4_normal_margin_residual_calibration.py with run dir runs/m783_v4_normal_margin_calibration

decision_rule: M783 may implement and run only a no-PPO residual calibration probe. It must not mutate the base actor, mutate the M761 residual head, run PPO, or promote a checkpoint.
